title: ZeRO3 quantized_nontrainable_weights flag overwrites quantized_weights instead
trigger_conditions: constructor caller did not pass zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights explicitly
root_cause: In zero.Init.__init__, when the deepspeed config has zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights=True but the local kwarg is False, the code mistakenly assigns the value to self.quantized_weights instead of self.quantized_nontrainable_weights — a copy-paste typo. Trainable weights end up being quantized while the nontrainable weights stay full precision (the opposite of what was requested).
diff_summary: Replace `self.quantized_weights = ...` with `self.quantized_nontrainable_weights = ...` on the misassigned line.
